_template_notes.purpose: Event propagation graph — Discovery #5. Domain events + integration events + producers/consumers + broker config (RabbitMQ + SignalR cho EUREKA). Source: GitNexus cypher + Serena find_referencing_symbols / fallback Grep IntegrationEvent|DomainEvent.
populate: events[]: 1 entry per event — {id, name (vd OrderCreatedIntegrationEvent), type=domain|integration|signalr, module, payload_schema}
propagation_paths[]: chain from initial trigger → final consumers — {event_chain, modules_traversed, latency_estimate?}
broker_config: {rabbitmq: {exchanges, queues, dead_letter}, signalr: {hubs, groups, methods}}
metadata.orphan_events: producer không có consumer (potential dead event)
metadata.unhandled_events: consumer reference event không có producer (broken contract)
